description: Fail Feed (feed.js), AI Sensor, Reactions + XP leveling system (reactions.js), and Failure Certificate generator (certificate.js). Depends on FEAT-002 (app.html, app.css, avatar-builder.js, app.js must all exist). FEAT-004 depends on this FEAT's reactions.js being complete.
steps: Create d:\Anti-LinkedIn\js\reactions.js. IIFE exposing window.Reactions. LocalStorage keys: sambatin_reactions (object keyed by postId), sambatin_xp (number). Internal helpers: _getAll() — JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sambatin_reactions')||'{}'); _saveAll(obj) — localStorage.setItem('sambatin_reactions',JSON.stringify(obj)); _getXP() — parseInt(localStorage.getItem('sambatin_xp')||'0'); _saveXP(n) — localStorage.setItem('sambatin_xp',String(n)); _fireXPEvent() — window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sambatin:xp-changed',{bubbles:true})). LEVEL THRESHOLDS (also used in app.js — keep in sync): var LEVELS=[{min:0,max:49,level:1,name:'Rapuh',color:'#9CA3AF'},{min:50,max:149,level:2,name:'Tahan Banting',color:'#60A5FA'},{min:150,max:299,level:3,name:'Kebal Revisi',color:'#A78BFA'},{min:300,max:499,level:4,name:'Kebal PHP HRD',color:'#F97316'},{min:500,max:999999,level:5,name:'Suhu Sambat',color:'#EF4444'}]. getLevel(xp): return LEVELS entry where xp>=t.min && xp<=t.max (fall back to last). getLevelName(xp): return getLevel(xp).name. getLevelColor(xp): return getLevel(xp).color. addReaction(postId, type): all=_getAll(); if(!all[postId]) all[postId]={pukpuk:0,ngakak:0,sama:0,myReactions:{pukpuk:false,ngakak:false,sama:false}}; var r=all[postId]; if(r.myReactions[type]){r[type]=Math.max(0,r[type]-1);r.myReactions[type]=false;_saveXP(Math.max(0,_getXP()-1));}else{r[type]++;r.myReactions[type]=true;_saveXP(_getXP()+1);} _saveAll(all); _fireXPEvent(); return r. addXP(amount): _saveXP(_getXP()+amount); _fireXPEvent(). getReactions(postId): all=_getAll(); return all[postId]||{pukpuk:0,ngakak:0,sama:0,myReactions:{pukpuk:false,ngakak:false,sama:false}}. window.Reactions={addReaction,addXP,getReactions,getLevel,getLevelName,getLevelColor,LEVELS}.

Create d:\Anti-LinkedIn\js\feed.js. IIFE exposing window.Feed. SEED POSTS (5 items, inserted only when sambatin_posts not in localStorage): post 1: {id:'seed1',username:'PejuangKubik_87',characterId:'panda',accessories:['id-card'],category:'Ditolak HRD',text:'Udah 5 tahap interview, presentasi proposal 20 halaman, bikin analisis kompetitor, terus HR-nya bilang "kami akan menghubungi kembali" — itu 3 bulan lalu. Yang berhasil ngebuka aplikasi LinkedIn mereka sekarang, tolong screenshot fotonya buat aku framing di kamar.',timestamp:Date.now()-3600000*5}. post 2: {id:'seed2',username:'MagangAbadi_Joko',characterId:'intern',accessories:['kopi'],category:'Salah Kirim Chat',text:'Niat mau curhat ke bestie soal bos killer, malah kekirim ke grup kantor "All Staff". Pesan aslinya: "Pak Direktur mirip karakter villain di film kartun tapi lebih jahat". Pak Direktur baca. Pak Direktur reply dengan 3 kata: "Senin ke HR."',timestamp:Date.now()-3600000*12}. post 3: {id:'seed3',username:'FreelancerKucingTua',characterId:'freelancer',accessories:['kopi','bendera'],category:'Bisnis Boncos',text:'Klien minta revisi ke-17. Jam 23.47. Pesannya: "Mas, bisa ganti semua warnanya jadi lebih... hidup? Dan fontnya kurang berjiwa." Tarif saya Rp150rb, sudah termasuk konseling trauma pasca-revisi. Belum bayar DP.',timestamp:Date.now()-3600000*24}. post 4: {id:'seed4',username:'SarjanaPenganggur',characterId:'php-victim',accessories:[],category:'Salah Jurusan',text:'Kuliah 4 tahun di Teknik Kimia. Lulus dengan IPK 3.7. Sekarang kerja di pabrik — pabrik mie instan divisi quality control rasa. Kata orang tua "kan masih nyambung sama kimia". Iya Bu, kimia bumbu kaldu sapi.',timestamp:Date.now()-3600000*36}. post 5: {id:'seed5',username:'KaryawanReguler_02',characterId:'panda',accessories:['kardus'],category:'Dimarahi Bos',text:'Rapat presentasi hasil Q3. Slide ke-7, bos nyela: "Data ini dari mana? Google? Ini bukan skripsi!" Semua orang lihat ke saya. Padahal datanya dari laporan internal yang dia kirim sendiri bulan lalu. Nomor halaman 23. Saya tunjukkan. Dia bilang "Meeting dilanjutkan Senin."',timestamp:Date.now()-3600000*48}. AI SENSOR: var BANNED_PHRASES=['alhamdulillah diterima','gaji dua digit','promosi jabatan','bangga mengumumkan','humbled and honored','excited to share','happy to announce','bersyukur diterima','naik jabatan','diterima kerja']. function _hasBanned(text): var t=text.toLowerCase(); return BANNED_PHRASES.some(function(p){return t.includes(p);}). CATEGORY COLORS: {'Ditolak HRD':'#EF4444','Salah Kirim Chat':'#F59E0B','Dimarahi Bos':'#8B5CF6','Bisnis Boncos':'#EF4444','Salah Jurusan':'#3B82F6'}. _relativeTime(ts): var diff=Date.now()-ts; if(diff<60000) return 'baru saja'; if(diff<3600000) return Math.floor(diff/60000)+' menit lalu'; if(diff<86400000) return Math.floor(diff/3600000)+' jam lalu'; return Math.floor(diff/86400000)+' hari lalu'. _renderPost(post): var rxn=Reactions.getReactions(post.id); var xp=0; (we don't have direct xp per post — use 0 for seed posts); var lvl=Reactions.getLevel(0); for seed posts level stays Rapuh. Actually compute from total reactions: var totalRxn=(rxn.pukpuk+rxn.ngakak+rxn.sama)*10; var lvl=Reactions.getLevel(totalRxn); return HTML string: '<div class="post-card" id="post-'+post.id+'">...' containing avatar svg (AvatarBuilder.getAvatarSVG(post.characterId,post.accessories,48)), post-username, level-badge (style using getLevelColor), cat-badge (style using category color), post.text, timestamp, reaction row with 3 buttons (data-post-id, data-reaction, .reacted class if myReactions[type] true, counts), cert button with data-post-id. _bindPost(postId): bind reaction button clicks for that post's card. On click: var updated=Reactions.addReaction(postId,type); re-query all 3 reaction buttons for that post and update their text counts and .reacted class. Bind cert button click: var post=getPosts().find(p=>p.id==postId); Certificate.openModal(post). getPosts(): JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sambatin_posts')||'null'). Feed.init(): var posts=getPosts(); if(!posts){posts=SEED_POSTS.slice();localStorage.setItem('sambatin_posts',JSON.stringify(posts));} var container=document.getElementById('feed-container'); container.innerHTML=''; posts.forEach(function(p){container.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',_renderPost(p));_bindPost(p.id);}); bind #post-text 'input' event: update #char-count span; run _hasBanned; toggle hidden on #ai-sensor-warning; toggle disabled on #post-submit-btn. bind #post-submit-btn click: validate category and text and !_hasBanned; build post obj {id:'post_'+Date.now(), username: localStorage.getItem('sambatin_username')||'BudakKorporat_'+(Math.floor(Math.random()*900)+100), characterId: (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sambatin_avatar')||'{}')).character||'panda', accessories: (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sambatin_avatar')||'{}')).accessories||[], category: select.value, text: textarea.value.trim(), timestamp:Date.now()}; var allPosts=getPosts()||[]; allPosts.unshift(post); localStorage.setItem('sambatin_posts',JSON.stringify(allPosts)); Reactions.addXP(10); container.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',_renderPost(post)); _bindPost(post.id); clear form; document.getElementById('tab-feed')?.scrollTo(0,0). window.Feed={init,getPosts}.

Create d:\Anti-LinkedIn\js\certificate.js. IIFE exposing window.Certificate. var _currentPost=null. Certificate.openModal(post): _currentPost=post; document.getElementById('cert-username').textContent=post.username; var catText=post.category+(post.text?' — '+post.text.substring(0,55)+(post.text.length>55?'...':''):''); document.getElementById('cert-category').textContent=catText; var months=['Januari','Februari','Maret','April','Mei','Juni','Juli','Agustus','September','Oktober','November','Desember']; var d=new Date(); document.getElementById('cert-date').textContent=d.getDate()+' '+months[d.getMonth()]+' '+d.getFullYear(); document.getElementById('modal-cert').removeAttribute('hidden'); document.getElementById('modal-overlay').removeAttribute('hidden'). Certificate.downloadCert(): var target=document.getElementById('cert-render-target'); html2canvas(target,{scale:2,useCORS:true,allowTaint:true,backgroundColor:'#F5C518'}).then(function(canvas){ var link=document.createElement('a'); link.download='sertifikat-sambatin.png'; link.href=canvas.toDataURL('image/png'); document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); document.body.removeChild(link); }).catch(function(e){ alert('Gagal download: '+e.message); }). DOMContentLoaded: bind #cert-download-btn click to Certificate.downloadCert. bind #cert-close-btn click: document.getElementById('modal-cert').setAttribute('hidden',''); document.getElementById('modal-overlay').setAttribute('hidden','').
acceptance_criteria: Feed tab shows 5 dummy Indonesian posts on first load with avatars, level badges, and category badges
AI sensor detects all 10 banned phrases in real time, disables post button, shows warning
AI sensor clears warning and re-enables button when banned text is removed
Posting a valid post adds it to the top of the feed and awards +10 XP
Reaction buttons (Puk-Puk, Ngakak Maaf, Sama Banget) increment counters and toggle .reacted class
Reactions persist in localStorage sambatin_reactions across page reload
XP in sambatin_xp increases with reactions and posting; header level badge updates
Clicking Buat Sertifikat on a post opens cert modal with correct username and category text
Clicking Download PNG downloads a PNG file from the certificate modal
Certificate modal closes when clicking the close button or modal overlay
verification: Open app.html, navigate to Beranda tab — confirm 5 posts render with correct Indonesian text
Open DevTools > Application > localStorage — confirm sambatin_posts has 5 entries after first load
Navigate to Buat Sambat tab, type 'alhamdulillah diterima' in textarea — button disabled, warning visible
Clear textarea — button re-enables, warning hides
Select a category, type valid text, click Posting Sambatan — post appears at top of feed, sambatin_xp increased by 10
Click Puk-Puk on a post — counter increments, button turns navy (.reacted), sambatin_reactions updated in localStorage
Click Puk-Puk again — counter decrements, button reverts
Click Buat Sertifikat on seed post — modal opens with username 'PejuangKubik_87' or similar and category text
Click Download PNG in cert modal — .png file downloads
Click X Tutup or modal overlay — cert modal closes
